about: GPU still reference renders of the Courtyard House (FLR-T-13.14, FLR-ADR-040): the editor's GPU still — its scene as apps/web/src/editor/three/still/gpu/scene.ts builds it from the worker's glTF export (prepareHouse, stillScene, perspectiveOf, roomCamera/presetCamera) and three-gpu-pathtracer's WebGPUPathTracer set as gpu/tracer.ts sets it (6 bounces, multiple importance sampling) — read back before the meter, the tone curve and the denoiser, as linear RGB in cd/m², box-filtered from 320 × 240 to 80 × 60. Little-endian float32, three a pixel, rows top to bottom.
device: Apple M4 Pro (apple metal-3), headless Chromium WebGPU
